convert_swin_pth_to_d2_pkl: convert a pretrained Swin Transformer .pth checkpoint to a Detectron2-compatible .pkl weight file
run_swin_model_conversion: run the Swin model conversion script with an input .pth file and output .pkl file path
prepare_swin_weights_for_detectron2: prepare Swin Transformer pretrained weights for use in a Detectron2 model config
extract_model_state_dict_from_pth: extract the model state dict from a Swin Transformer .pth checkpoint file using torch.load
dump_detectron2_weight_pickle: dump a Detectron2-compatible weight dictionary with matching heuristics to a pickle file
